cues.title: 先看杂交第一代
cues.caption: 父母各给一个，保留来源。
cues.captionEn: One from each parent; keep the source.
cues.zh: 摩尔根发现白眼雄果蝇后，用它与红眼雌果蝇杂交。教材的纯合红眼母本给每个后代一个带显性因子的X。父本给女儿X，给儿子Y，因此子一代雌雄都表现红眼。画面把性别、眼色和染色体来源分别标出，避免只看一个总体比例。
cues.en: After finding a white-eyed male fly, Morgan crossed it with a red-eyed female. In the textbook model, the homozygous red-eyed mother supplies a dominant X to every offspring. The father supplies X to daughters and Y to sons, so both sexes in F1 are red-eyed. Track sex, eye color and chromosome origin separately.

cues.title: 把性别一起记下来
cues.titleEn: Record sex as well as eye color
cues.caption: 白眼与性别的关联，需要解释。
cues.captionEn: Explain the link between eye color and sex.
cues.zh: 让子一代的雌雄果蝇交配。母方有两种X，父方有红眼X和Y。跟随配子标记进入四种后代。白眼只出现在获得隐性X和Y的组合中。总体红白比接近三比一还不够；白眼与性别的关联，才是这里需要解释的新证据。
cues.en: Mate the F1 female and male. The mother has two X forms; the father provides either the red-eye X or Y. Trace these gametes into four offspring classes. White eyes occur only with a recessive X and Y. An overall three-to-one color ratio is not enough: association with sex is the new evidence to explain.

cues.title: 测交检验新预测
cues.caption: 测交预测，也允许白眼雌蝇。
cues.captionEn: The test cross predicts white-eyed females.
cues.zh: 把杂合红眼雌蝇与白眼雄蝇测交。如果白眼因子在X上，母方的两种X，分别与父方的白眼X或Y结合，理论上得到红眼雌、白眼雌、红眼雄和白眼雄四类。这里出现白眼雌蝇，说明白眼并不是雄性专属的性状。
cues.en: Cross the heterozygous red-eyed female with a white-eyed male. If the locus is X-linked, the two maternal X types combine with the paternal recessive X or Y to yield four predicted classes: red and white females, and red and white males. White-eyed females show that the trait is not restricted to males.

cues.title: 亲本角色交换后会怎样
cues.titleEn: What changes when parental roles reverse?
cues.caption: 交换亲本性别，预测随之改变。
cues.captionEn: Reverse the parents; test a new prediction.
cues.zh: 再做一个对照：白眼雌蝇与红眼雄蝇杂交。女儿都从父亲得到红眼X，所以表现红眼；儿子从父亲得到Y，唯一的X来自白眼母亲，因此表现白眼。交换亲本的性别改变了结果，X连锁模型能够给出这个可检验的预测。百分比来自模型，不是假造的原始计数。
cues.en: Reverse the cross: a white-eyed female with a red-eyed male. Daughters receive their father’s red-eye X and are red-eyed. Sons receive his Y and their only X from the white-eyed mother, making them white-eyed. X linkage predicts this difference. Percentages are theoretical, not fabricated historical counts.

cues.title: 先比较观察记录
cues.caption: 比较观察报告，不模拟个人视觉。
cues.zh: 道尔顿把自己和弟弟的颜色观察，与其他人的描述进行比较。教材记录，他在白天和烛光下报告不同颜色，其他人则把花说成粉红色。这里展示的是观察记录的差异，不用屏幕颜色假装复原某个人的精确视觉。这类观察提出问题，遗传解释还需要家系证据。
cues.en: Dalton compared his and his brother’s color observations with other people’s descriptions. The textbook records a difference between daylight and candlelight for them, while others described the flower as pink. This is a comparison of reports, not a screen simulation of anyone’s exact vision. Genetic explanations require family evidence as well.

cues.title: 沿真实家系保留不确定性
cues.titleEn: Follow the pedigree without erasing uncertainty
cues.caption: 实心是观察，圆点是推断。
cues.zh: 跟着教材家系走。第一代的父亲有红绿色觉障碍；第二代三号女儿表型未受影响，但在教材的X连锁隐性模型下可推断为携带者。她的儿子中又出现受影响者。圆点是模型推断，实心才是观察到的表型。有些女性仍可能对应两个基因型，现有资料不能强行确定。
cues.en: Follow the textbook pedigree. The affected first-generation father has an unaffected daughter, individual two-three, inferred to be a carrier under the textbook’s X-recessive assumptions. An affected son appears in her family. Dots represent inference; filled symbols represent observed phenotype. Some women retain two possible genotypes because the available evidence does not resolve them.

cues.title: 先明确被调查的人群
cues.caption: 人群比例，要保留抽样分母。
cues.zh: 现在切换到二百人的合成练习资料。逐步选取样本，分子统计受影响人数，分母统计被调查人数。探索时可只选已有受影响成员的家庭，观察选择偏倚；也可改为男性或女性分母。这些都是教学数据，不是任何真实人群的患病率。
cues.en: Switch to a synthetic classroom population of two hundred people. As the sample grows, count affected people over surveyed people. Exploration restricts sampling to households already containing affected members to expose selection bias, or changes the sex-specific denominator. These are teaching data, not prevalence estimates for a real population.

cues.title: 合并人数，而不是平均百分比
cues.titleEn: Pool people instead of averaging percentages
cues.caption: 合并人数，先去重，再计算。
cues.zh: 第一组二十人中有两人受影响，第二组八十人中有一人。合并后是三除以一百，等于百分之三，不能直接把两个百分比取平均。若同一个人被两个小组重复登记，还要先去重。家系资料帮助分析传递方式；规范的人群抽样才回答人群比例问题。
cues.en: Two of twenty people are affected in one group, and one of eighty in another. Pooled, that is three of one hundred, or three percent, not the simple average of the two percentages. Duplicate registrations must first be removed. Pedigrees address transmission patterns; population sampling addresses proportions.

chapters.captionEn: When F1 flies mate, white-eyed offspring in this model are male.

chapters.caption: 白眼雌蝇与红眼雄蝇杂交，女儿红眼、儿子白眼。
chapters.captionEn: A white-eyed female crossed with a red-eyed male predicts red daughters and white sons.

chapters.captionEn: Different observers reported different colors for the same flower and illumination.

chapters.caption: 受影响父亲可把X传给女儿，再由女儿传给儿子。
chapters.captionEn: An affected father can transmit his X through a daughter to her son.

label.en: Morgan’s white-eye fly crosses and test crosses

label.zh: 道尔顿色盲观察与红绿色盲系谱分析
label.en: Dalton’s color observations and red–green color-vision pedigrees
Surveying inherited conditions in a population

question.zh: 白眼为什么与果蝇性别一起出现？
question.en: Why is white eye associated with sex in these crosses?

lead.zh: 把父母各提供的X或Y保留下来，再比较正交、测交和反交。
lead.en: Retain the maternal and paternal X or Y, then compare crosses.

principle.zh: 在教材的X连锁隐性模型下，性别与表型联合分类检验同一遗传解释。
principle.en: In the textbook X-recessive model, joint sex–phenotype classes test one inheritance explanation.

question.zh: 把白眼雌蝇与红眼雄蝇交配，女儿和儿子还会一样吗？
question.en: Would daughters and sons match after crossing a white-eyed female with a red-eyed male?

explanation.zh: 父亲给女儿显性X、给儿子Y；女儿表现红眼，儿子从母方得到隐性X而表现白眼。这是模型预测，不是替代原始观察数。
explanation.en: The father gives daughters a dominant X and sons a Y. Daughters are red-eyed; sons inherit the maternal recessive X and are white-eyed. These are model expectations, not historical counts.

question.zh: 没有表现色盲，就能排除隐性因子吗？
question.en: Does an unaffected phenotype exclude a recessive allele?

lead.zh: 先比较观察记录，再从父母和子女关系推断；保留仍有两种可能的人。
lead.en: Compare reported observations, then constrain genotypes through relatives while keeping unresolved alternatives.

principle.zh: 系谱的实心符号是观察，携带者圆点是特定遗传模型下的推断。
principle.en: Filled pedigree symbols are observations; carrier dots are inferences under a specified inheritance model.

question.zh: I-2外表正常，能直接写成两个显性因子吗？
question.en: Can unaffected I-2 be assigned two dominant alleles immediately?

explanation.zh: 不能。教材关系允许两种基因型；正常表型不足以排除隐性因子。
explanation.en: No. Both genotypes remain compatible with the textbook relationships; phenotype alone does not exclude the recessive allele.

question.zh: 两组调查比例，为什么不能直接平均？
question.en: Why not simply average two survey percentages?

lead.zh: 跟住固定人群中的身份，用被调查人数作分母，合并时先去重。
lead.en: Track fixed participant identities, retain denominators, and remove duplicate registrations before pooling.

principle.zh: 人群比例需要明确抽样范围与分母；重复记录不等于新增个体。
principle.en: Population proportions require a specified sampling frame and denominator; a duplicate record is not a new person.

question.zh: 2/20与1/80合并以后是多少？多录五条已有记录会改变结果吗？
question.en: What is the pooled result of 2/20 and 1/80, and do five duplicate records change it?

explanation.zh: 100名不同个体中3人，即3%；先按身份去重，重复登记不改变这个比例。
explanation.en: There are 3 affected individuals among 100 unique people: 3%. Identity-based deduplication preserves that proportion.
